title: Grace, Late Dues Fee and Reinstatement Figures on the Circle Tiers
content:
| Figure | Circle Free Membership | Circle Plus Annual | Circle Total Annual | Circle Total Household Annual | Circle Business Pro | Circle Business Elite |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Grace days after dues fall due | 0 | 21 | 30 | 30 | 45 | 60 |
| Late dues fee (USD) | 0.00 | 5.00 | 9.00 | 9.00 | 25.00 | 40.00 |
| Reinstatement window (days) | 0 | 60 | 90 | 90 | 120 | 180 |
| Reinstatement fee (USD) | 0.00 | 10.00 | 20.00 | 20.00 | 50.00 | 75.00 |
| Reinstatements allowed on one record | 0 | 1 | 2 | 2 | 3 | 4 |

Whether benefits stop being usable while a Northbeam Circle Membership sits in grace is recorded per
tier as well:

| Tier | Benefits suspended while in grace |
|---|---|
| Circle Free Membership | no |
| Circle Plus Annual | yes |
| Circle Total Annual | yes |
| Circle Total Household Annual | yes |
| Circle Business Pro | no |
| Circle Business Elite | no |

## The figures on this schedule

The grace days are the calendar days a membership stays in grace after dues fall due. The late dues fee
is charged when dues are still unpaid at the end of grace. The reinstatement window is the calendar days
after a lapse within which the former tier may be reinstated, the reinstatement fee is charged to
reinstate at that former tier, and the reinstatement allowance is the most reinstatements allowed on one
membership record.

## How the three consumer figures scale

Grace lengthens with the tier: 21 days on Circle Plus Annual, 30 on Circle Total Annual and on Circle
Total Household Annual, 45 on Circle Business Pro and 60 on Circle Business Elite, with Circle Free
Membership carrying 0. On every tier carrying dues the reinstatement window is the longer of the two
periods — 60 days against 21 on Circle Plus Annual, 180 against 60 on Circle Business Elite. Benefit
suspension in grace follows the market side rather than the rank: it is recorded on Circle Plus Annual,
Circle Total Annual and Circle Total Household Annual, and is not recorded on Circle Free Membership,
Circle Business Pro or Circle Business Elite, whose late dues fees stand at 0.00, 25.00 and 40.00 and
whose reinstatement fees stand at 0.00, 50.00 and 75.00.
